svg.title: amp Library view filtered to Playlists
svg.desc: A mockup of amp's Library view with the Playlists filter active. At the top, an active Bluetooth button. Below, a yellow brutalist block header reads Library. A row of four filter chips follows: Albums, Artists, Songs, and Playlists, with Playlists rendered as a dark-navy inversion indicating it is the selected filter. Below the filter chips, a full-width brutalist button reads plus NEW PLAYLIST with a plus icon. Underneath, five playlist rows are listed as plain text rows with playlist name in bold and metadata in muted mono type: Morning Commute with 42 tracks and 2 hours 18 minutes, Late Night with 28 tracks and 1 hour 52 minutes, Workout with 19 tracks and 1 hour 8 minutes, Rainy Sunday with 35 tracks and 2 hours 4 minutes, and Road Trip 2024 with 67 tracks and 4 hours 31 minutes. At the bottom, the four-tab navigation bar with Library selected as a dark-navy inversion.
